static_chain.three_byte_branch: if descriptor source bytes-per-sample equals 3, reads three bytes per sample and stores a short via a bitwise carry expression
static_chain.separate_float_branch: four-byte exponent/mantissa-style input returns float; no call edge from the three-byte branch

approved_input_contract: F01.3 describes 38-channel PCM24 U24LE signed interpretation and byte addressing; it does not grant permission to transplant an unbound native short or float branch.
minimum_capture: One same-generation nonzero signed PCM24 sample coordinate, the corresponding first-DSP F32 input bits and owner/row tokens; discard sample immediately. A value without typed call lineage is only a scalar cross-check.
